title: Makhni Gravy
intro: Its healthy, super easy to make vegan ( just dont add butter) and is ready in under an hour. I found the biggest advantage is that you can cool the gravy down, box it and freeze till you need it on a rainy day :)

items: 2 tbsp oil or 1 tbsp oil + 2 tbsp butter
1/2 kg tomatoes, around 9 medium sized , chopped
salt, to taste as per your preferece

method: In a large pan, add in your oil or butter and allow it to heat slightly

Add in your spices as mentioned above and saute them till they start turning colour. if using butter, the butter will start to turn to a dark brown do not worry as this is due to it having a lower smoke point than oil, also, it adds flavour
Add in your onion then and saute till translucent.
Follow that up with your tomatoes + cashew and allow the mix to cook covered for 10 - 15 minutes till your tomatoes are super soft and cooked through
Let this mix cool down slightly and blitze till smooth. you can add a few tbsp of water at this point.

Add your blended mix back on the stove and heat it. add in your red chilli powder + tomato puree paste + salt +1/4 cup warm water and mix . Let this cook for another 10 - 15 minutes ( you will see the gravy getting a slightly darker colour)
At this stage, you can add in your cooked tandoori chicken or tandoori paneer to make a butter chicken / butter paneer.
Top with kasturi methi, stir it in and switch off the gas
Storage: this gravy freezes well on its own without any chicken or paneer for upto 2 months.

caption:
This Makhni Gravy will blow your mind!!!! 
its healthy, super easy to make vegan ( just dont add butter) and is ready in under an hour. 

I found the biggest advantage is that you can cool the gravy down, box it and freeze till you need it on a rainy day :) 

Ingredients: 
Spices: 
8 garlic cloves
3 cardamom pods, green
3 cloves
6 kashmiri red chilli, dried
1/2 tsp cinnamon powder

Gravy: 
2 tbsp oil or 1 tbsp oil + 2 tbsp butter
1 onion, chopped
1/2 kg tomatoes, around 9 medium sized , chopped
a handful of cashew nuts 
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tbsp of ketchup
1 heaping tbsp on kasturi methi
salt, to taste as per your preferece

Method:
- In a large pan, add in your oil or butter and allow it to heat slightly
- add in your spices as mentioned above and saute them till they start turning colour. if using butter, the butter will start to turn to a dark brown do not worry as this is due to it having a lower smoke point than oil, also, it adds flavour
- add in your onion then and saute till translucent. 
- follow that up with your tomatoes + cashew and allow the mix to cook covered for 10 - 15 minutes till your tomatoes are super soft and cooked through
- let this mix cool down slightly and blitze till smooth. you can add a few tbsp of water at this point.
- add your blended mix back on the stove and heat it. add in your red chilli powder + tomato puree paste + salt +1/4 cup warm water and mix . Let this cook for another 10 - 15 minutes ( you will see the gravy getting a slightly darker colour)
- at this stage, you can add in your cooked tandoori chicken or tandoori paneer to make a butter chicken / butter paneer. 
- top with kasturi methi, stir it in and switch off the gas

Storage: this gravy freezes well on its own without any chicken or paneer for upto 2 months.
